paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat bel hong hau in athupi mahmah a, huchi in Ahab toh kizopna abawl hi.
heading: Zawlnei Mikaiah In Ahab Avauhilhna / (1 Kum 22.1-28)

paite: Kum bangzah hiam nung in Samaria ah Ahab kiang ah ahohsuk a, Ahab in amah leh aheute belam leh bawngtalte tampi ana goh a, Ramoth-gilead a hohtouhpih ding in achial hi.

Israel kumpipa Ahab in Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ramoth-gilead ah i hohtoukhawm kei dia hia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, gal i doukhawm ding uh," achi hi.
Jehoshaphat in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "TOUPA thu hungaih phot lai in," achi hi.

Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n, zawlneite mi zali asamkhawm a, akiang uah, "Ramoth-gilead khua sual ding in ka kuan ding uam, kuan lou ding?" achi hi. Amau, "Kuan in, Pathian in kumpipa khut ah ape ding," achi uhi.
Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "TOUPA zawlnei kuate hiam i dot ding a-om kei ua eita aw?" achi hi.

Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "TOUPA hon dotsak ding mi khat a-om; himahleh amah bel ka muhdah lamtak ahi; ka tungtang thu ahoih lou lam kia lou ngal ahoih lam himhim agen ngei kei a; huai mi bel Imla tapa Mikaiah ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n heutu khat asam a, "Imla tapa Mikaiah hon pi meng dih," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Samaria kulh kongpi lutna chin mun awng ah akumpi puan ua kizem in alaltutphah tuaktuak uah atu ua; zawlnei tengteng in ama uah thu agen uhi.
Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in sik kiite abawl a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiaite in Siriate mangthang sipsip khop in na sual ding achi," achi hi.
Huchi mah bang in zawlnei dangte'n leng, "Ramoth-gilead ah hoh inla, lamzang in; TOUPA'N kumpipa khut ah ape ding hi," chi in agen uhi.

Mikaiah sam dia asawlpa un, "Ngai dih, zawlneite'n kithutuaktak in ahoih lam in kumpipa kiang ah thu agen chiat ua; huaiziak in nang leng achihsa bang un ahoih lam in va gen sam dih ve," chi in agen hi.
Huan Mikaiah in, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka chi hi, ka Pathian in achih bang geih in ahi ka gen ding," achi hi.

Huchi in kumpipa kiang atun in kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mikaiah, Ramoth-gilead khua sual ding in ka kuan ding uam, kuan lou ding?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Kuan unla, va lamzang un, na khut a piak ahi ding hi," achi hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Thutak keleu lou ka kiang ah TOUPA min a gen lou ding in bangzah vei ahia nang ka hon kichiamsak ding?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Belamchingtu nei lou bang in Israel tengteng tang ah dalhzak in ka mu a; TOUPA'N, hiaite'n heutu anei kei ua, amau inn lam ah lungmuangtak in pai diam uhen achi," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Ka tungtang thu zaw aselam kia lou ngal ahoih lam himhim ahihleh agen sam kei ding chih ka hon hilh ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Mikaiah in agen nawn a, "TOUPA thu ngaikhia un, TOUPA alaltutphah a tu, van mipite tengteng ataklam leh aveilam a dingh ka mu hi.
TOUPA'N Ramoth-gilead a Israel kumpipa Ahab kuantou a, va si ding a kua'n ahia khem ding? achih chiang in khat in, 'Huchi khachi in' achi a, midang in, 'Huchibang khachibang in' achi hi.
Kha khat ahong pawt a, TOUPA ma a dingh in, 'Ke'n ka khem ding,' achi hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, 'Bang in eita?' achi hi.
Ama'n, 'Ka va hoh ding a, zawlneite tengteng kam ah kha zuauthei in ka va suak ding,' achi hi. Huan ama'n, 'Na va khem ngei ding a, na lohching ding, kuan inla, huchibang in hih in,' " achi hi.
Huchi in ngai dih, TOUPA'N, "Hiai zawlneite kam ah kha zuauthei akoih a; na tungthu TOUPA'N ahoih lou lam in agenta ahi," achi hi.
Huaitak in Kenaanah tapa Zedekiah in ava naih a, Mikaiah biang ah abeng a, "Na kiang a thugen ding TOUPA kha in koilam a hon pawtsan ahia?" achi hi.
Mikaiah in, "Ngai dih, dantan sunggil a bu ding a na lut ni chiang in na hon thei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa'n, "Mikaiah pi unla, kho ukpa Ammon leh kumpipa tapa kiang ah paipih nawn un.
Kumpipa'n hichi in achi a, 'Hiai mi suangkul ah khum unla, lungmuangtak a ka hong pai nawn masiah gimthuakna an leh gimthuakna tui pia un,' achi a, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
Huan Mikaiah in, "Lungmuang- tak a na hong pai nawn peuhmahleh TOUPA'N kei hon zang a thu gen lou ahi ding hi," achi a, amah mah in, "Nou mipi tengteng in leng na za un," achi hi.
Ramoth-gilead ah Israel kumpipa leh Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat ava hohtou uhi.
heading: Ahab Sihna / (1 Kum 22.29-35)

paite: Israel kumpipa'n Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Kei ka kibawl lamdang ding a, kisualna ah ka hoh sam ding; nang zaw na kumpipa puan kisilh in," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa bel akibawl lamdang a, kidouna ah ahohtou hi.
Siria kumpipa'n akangtalaite tung a heutute kiang ah, "Israel kumpipa lou ngal mineu leng milian leng na sual ding uh ahi kei," chi in thu apia hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, "Kangtalai tung a heutute'n Jehoshaphat amuh uleh Israel kumpipa ahi ve," achi ua. Huchi in sual tum in a-umta uhi; himahleh Jehoshaphat akikou a, TOUPA'N apanpihta a, huchi in Pathian in amau amah anusesak hi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, kangtalai tung a heutute'n Israel kumpipa ahi kei chih atheih un delh nawn lou in akiksanta uhi.

Mi khat in ngim tuam nei lou in athalpeu alai a, Israel kumpipa a-awmphaw leh a-awmphaw kikal ah akha a, huchi in akangtalai hawlpa kiang ah, "Lehhawl inla, mipi lak a kipan hon paikhiakpih in, liamna natak ka tuak hi," achi hi.
Huai ni in kisualna athupi mahmah a; Israel kumpipa bel Siriate lam nga in akangtalai ah nitaklam tanpha in adingh a; huan nitum kuan in asita hi.
